faq.heading: Common questions
faq.a1: If your company operates in one of the 18 critical sectors (energy, transport, health, digital infrastructure, etc.) and has 50+ employees or €10M+ revenue, you are very likely in scope. Our free applicability check takes 2 minutes and gives you a clear answer.
faq.q2: We already have ISO 27001. Isn't that enough?
faq.a2: ISO 27001 covers roughly 60–70% of NIS2 requirements. But NIS2 adds obligations around incident reporting (24h/72h), supply chain security, management liability, and BSI registration that ISO 27001 does not address. Our platform covers all of these.
faq.q3: How much does it cost after the free period?
faq.a3: We're finalizing pricing for general availability. Founding partners lock in preferential pricing for the lifetime of their account. We'll share details during the demo call.
faq.a4: Most companies complete their initial compliance baseline within 2–4 weeks. We onboard you within 48 hours, and the platform guides you through each step. No 6-month implementation projects.
faq.a5: All data is hosted in Germany. We use encryption at rest and in transit, role-based access controls, and maintain a complete audit trail. We practice what we preach.
faq.q6: What happens after the free months?
faq.a6: You transition to a paid plan at the rate discussed during onboarding. No surprise pricing. If you decide it's not for you, we help you export all your data. No lock-in.
